title: The Caf\'e in Amsterdam: When the Incumbent Becomes the Oracle
abstract: arXiv:2607.13393v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A field can reformulate its computations freely exactly where its demand is stated independently of any incumbent implementation, and finds itself unable to when the incumbent's own output has quietly become the specification. This note offers that observation as a lens on computational reformulation for modern accelerators, where posing a problem in a hardware-friendly form can yield large speed and energy gains, but only if a replacement can be judged at all. translated_title: 阿姆斯特丹的咖啡馆：当现有系统成为“神谕”
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.13393v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：一个领域可以在其需求独立于任何现有实现被明确表述的地方自由地重新表述其计算，但当现有系统的输出悄然成为规范时，它便无法做到这一点。本文将此观察作为理解现代加速器计算重构的视角，其中以硬件友好的形式提出问题可以带来巨大的速度和能源收益，但前提是替代方案能够被评判。基于测试神谕问题（Weyuker; Barr等人）、需求工程中的实现偏见概念（Zave和Jackson），以及通过可接受性而非数值接近性评判近似设计的案例（Felzmann等人），本文将这一病理命名为“基线捕获”：即现有系统不再是需求可被满足的证据，而成为满足需求的定义。随后，它区分了两个容易被混淆的问题：是否……
tldr: 本文提出“基线捕获”概念，指出现有系统从证明需求可满足的证据变成需求定义本身，阻碍了现代加速器上的计算重构，并区分了替代方案评判中的关键问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "baseline capture," where an incumbent system shifts from evidence of feasibility to the definition of meeting a demand, hindering computational reformulation on modern accelerators, and separates two easily confused questions in evaluating replacements.
